{{Top|leg}}
'''The Bog''' was the nickname given to the recreation center at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outpost [[DVL-181]]. Primarily used by the base's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], it had previously been the facility's mess hall and rec center.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
